title: Inverse image and tensor product
statement:
Inverse image $g^*\colon\D(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E)\to\D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E)$ along a morphism $g\colon X\to Y$
preserves $\Dbc(-,\mathcal O_E)$, and on these categories it agrees, after restriction of scalars to
$\underline{\mathcal O_E}$, with the completed inverse image of the Stacks Project. For
$K,L\in\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$, the tensor product $K\otimes_{\mathcal O_{E,X}}^{\mathbf L}L\in\D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E)$,
without completion, lies in $\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$. Extension by zero along a quasi-compact open immersion and
direct image along a closed immersion preserve $\Dbc(-,\mathcal O_E)$.

Arguments by dévissage along a stratification need inverse image, tensor products and extension by zero
along strata to preserve integral constructible complexes; these are the statements above.

proof.text: For open extension use lem-sfb-dc-open-lower-shriek-preserves. For a closed immersion take its open complement, which is quasi-compact on the Noetherian target. Condensed open-closed recollement supplies exact closed direct image. Its exact derived homology comparison and constructible_open_closed_images give bounded constructibility for the right-derived presentation. These are the open/closed assertions in the first paragraph of the unit proof.

source.place: Extension by zero and closed direct image

proof.text: Apply lem-sfb-dc-upper-star-preserves to the given morphism of schemes over k. On X identify boundedConstructible with finite constant-model bounded constructibility by lem-sfb-adic-constructibility-predicate-comparison. Choose a generator of the principal maximal ideal of the embedded coefficient integers. Apply only the completeness direction of clause (2) of sk-lem-integral-models to the image: it is intrinsically derived complete. IntegralPullbackIsCompleted now uses exactly that existing canonical completeness predicate. Cartesian exact inverse image identifies the finite cone units with the reductions of the image, and the principal completion criterion and cofinality of ell and uniformizer powers identify this with the completed inverse-image comparison. The definition/interface equivalence and all consumer checks are recorded in coord/changes/S7-integral-pullback-completion-predicate.md.

source.place: Canonical comparison is an isomorphism iff the image is derived complete; integral models clauses (1),(2)

proof.text: Apply the existing integral-coefficient instance of lem-sfb-dc-tensor-preserves to K and L. Its conclusion is the ambient uncompleted derived tensor, and its proof uses the finite truncation devissage. This supplies precisely the tensor assertion in the unit proof; no completed tensor or new tensor construction is introduced.
